record.content: The official Garin page describes Arroyo Flats as a reservable group campsite for 25 through 75 people with five 10-foot tables, a double BBQ, drinking fountain, fire circle with benches, and two chemical toilets. Reservations must be made at least three business days in advance by phone. It also publishes seasonal gate hours, a 10pm-5am curfew, and park-entry fees.
